items.title: Conceição do Mato Dentro (MG) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 1 #6
items.en_title: Conceição do Mato Dentro (MG) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 1 #6
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Conceição do Mato Dentro (MG) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 7,644,421.88; proposals close Dec 1, 16:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
